version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This Linear integration is purpose-aligned and clearly discloses its network, OAuth, write, function, and trigger behavior with user-approval safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Network access, a Maton account, and Linear authorization are necessary for the stated API gateway behavior; raw API-key HTTP use is limited to environments where the CLI cannot be installed and includes handling warnings.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It recommends installing a pinned Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and authenticating with managed OAuth; this is disclosed and consistent with the integration purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list operations, require explicit approval for connection creation, mutations, hosted functions, trigger destinations, and local --exec use, and treat third-party content as untrusted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, connections, hosted functions, and triggers can persist, but the artifact describes their scope, deletion paths, and approval requirements, including warnings for persistent event forwarding.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is coherently focused on Linear API access through Maton for issues, projects, teams, cycles, labels, comments, and Linear-triggered automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend to let Maton access your Linear workspace. Review OAuth scopes during connection, approve writes and automations only when the target resource and effect are clear, and be especially careful with triggers or destinations because they can keep forwarding future event data until deleted.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found disclosed, purpose-aligned behavior rather than hidden or incompatible capability.
[A.I.G SARIF results empty] expected: The static scan returned no findings; manual review found sensitive capabilities such as OAuth, mutations, functions, and triggers, but they are documented with user-control requirements.
